name: eval2 batch (6b): the other 26 pictures of the Gate D list, matched to the signed-off samples. Level file levels/LEVEL-eval2.md, Gates A to E signed 25 Oct 2026.
notes: Cut-outs keyed with tools/keywhite.py; close-ups saved at the walls' size, JPEG 88. Edits reference their base by case id, so they run after it.

cases.prompt:
Style: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, not a picture book for toddlers; clean dark-ink outlines on everything, a shadow side on every object and soft cast shadows from one light source, so things sit solidly on their surfaces; smooth colour with gentle shading, a faint paper-grain texture and a gentle vignette at the edges. Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. The attached picture is a crop from the room this belongs to: copy only its style, hand and palette, not its objects. Palette of the room: warm cream walls, honey wood floor and furniture, dark stained wood, soft rainy-afternoon light from a window. Draw it alone on a pure flat white background: no surface, no shadow on the ground, no frame, no border, no text, nothing else in the picture. The object fills most of the frame. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.
